repositories.name: morluto/rea
repositories.summary: Reverse Engineer Anything (REA) - Autonomous AI Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and CLI orchestrator bridging Ghidra, Hopper, and IDA Pro directly into LLM coding agents.
technicalHighlights: First-class Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Claude, Cursor, and custom agent teams
Headless Ghidra & IDA Pro bridge turning raw decompiled bytecode into semantic AST representations
Automated cross-reference walking, function signature recovery, and struct reconstruction in seconds
repositories.paradigmShift: Transitions reverse engineering from manual mouse-driven disassembly to conversational, multi-agent AI binary interrogation.

repositories.name: alpa-projects/llm4decompile
repositories.summary: First open-source Large Language Model trained specifically for binary-to-C source decompilation, re-synthesizing readable source with variable and type semantics.
technicalHighlights: Trained on billions of tokens of assembly-to-source pairs across optimization levels (O0-O3)
Recovers human-readable variable names, structures, and control flow without symbol tables
Outperforms classical rule-based heuristics on syntax validity and re-compilability metrics
repositories.paradigmShift: Proves deep transformers can invert compiler optimization passes that stripped structural metadata.

repositories.name: JusticeRage/Gepetto
repositories.summary: The pioneer plugin integrating OpenAI and local LLMs into IDA Pro & Ghidra to automatically explain assembly, rename cryptic variables, and reconstruct complex data structures.
technicalHighlights: Contextual prompt engineering providing IDA decompiler pseudo-C to LLMs
Direct AST mutation for symbol renames and structured comments in Hex-Rays / Ghidra
Sparked the explosion of AI-augmented reverse engineering plugins across 2023-2025
repositories.paradigmShift: Showed that reverse engineers could multiply their audit speeds 10x by delegating function summarization to LLMs.

repositories.name: WerWolv/ImHex
repositories.summary: A modern, gorgeous, custom-pattern-driven Hex Editor built from the ground up for reverse engineers, security researchers, and eye health with ImGui & custom pattern language.
technicalHighlights: Custom C-like Pattern Language for declarative parsing of complex binary formats
Integrated decompiler, disassembler, byte entropy visualizer, and data diffing engine
Modern C++20 cross-platform GPU-accelerated interface
repositories.paradigmShift: Replaced clunky 1990s hex editors with an extensible, visually stunning reverse engineering workbench.

repositories.name: jtgrassie/dogbolt
repositories.summary: The Godbolt Compiler Explorer equivalent for decompilers. Runs uploaded binaries simultaneously through Ghidra, Hex-Rays, angr, Binary Ninja, Boomerang, and RetDec for instant side-by-side comparative analysis.
technicalHighlights: Headless orchestration of 8+ commercial and open-source decompiler engines
Interactive web diffing showing variations in control flow recovery across engines
Essential benchmark utility for compiler and decompiler authors
repositories.paradigmShift: Democratized the benchmarking and comparative evaluation of decompilers across the industry.

repositories.name: NationalSecurityAgency/ghidra
repositories.summary: Declassified by the NSA at RSA 2019. Ghidra revolutionized the reverse engineering world by giving the global community an enterprise-grade decompiler, Sleigh processor modeling engine, and collaborative headless server completely free and open source.
technicalHighlights: Sleigh specification language translating machine code to intermediate P-Code
Decompiler core (written in C++) executing SSA-based control-flow & data-flow graph reconstruction
Multi-user shared repository server for distributed team reverse engineering
Cross-platform Java UI with rich Python & Java API automation
repositories.paradigmShift: Shattered the multi-thousand-dollar proprietary monopoly in software decompilation overnight.

repositories.name: rizinorg/cutter
repositories.summary: Free and Open Source graphical reverse engineering platform powered by Rizin (radare2 fork) featuring integrated Ghidra decompiler plugin, graph view, and native C++/Qt UI.
technicalHighlights: Modular architecture linking Rizin CLI core with high-performance Qt UI
Native integration with the Ghidra decompiler engine without needing a JVM runtime
Jupyter notebook integration, binary emulation, and symbol search
repositories.paradigmShift: Delivered an ultra-fast, native C++ desktop alternative to Ghidra's heavy memory-intensive Java runtime.

repositories.name: mandiant/capa
repositories.summary: The FLARE team's open-source tool that automatically identifies capabilities in executable files (e.g. 'installs hook', 'injects into process', 'encrypts files') using human-readable YAML rules.
technicalHighlights: Rule-based pattern matching over call graphs, API sequences, and byte patterns
Vivisect, PEFile, Ghidra, and IDA Pro backends
ATT&CK and MBC (Malware Behavior Catalog) alignment mapping
repositories.paradigmShift: Eliminated hours of manual triage by instantly telling analysts WHAT a binary can do before reading a single line of disassembly.

repositories.name: radareorg/radare2
repositories.summary: The legendary UNIX-philosophy reverse engineering framework and commandline toolset capable of analyzing, disassembling, patching, and debugging nearly every architecture known to mankind.
technicalHighlights: Scriptable command-line interface with single-character command chaining
Universal binary format parser (ELF, PE, Mach-O, DEX, GameBoy, raw firmware)
ESIL (Evaluable Strings Intermediate Language) for micro-emulation and symbolic evaluation
repositories.paradigmShift: Brought reverse engineering to terminal purists and embedded firmware hackers with lightning performance.

repositories.name: qilingframework/qiling
repositories.summary: True advanced binary emulation framework. Unlike CPU-only emulators (Unicorn), Qiling emulates entire operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOS, QNX, UEFI, DOS) including kernel APIs, sys-calls, and file systems.
technicalHighlights: Cross-architecture (x86, ARM, MIPS) and cross-OS dynamic emulation
Intercepts Windows kernel APIs and POSIX syscalls inside a Python sandbox
Automated IoT/router firmware fuzzing and malware unpacker
repositories.paradigmShift: Enabled safe, high-speed emulation of complex malware and IoT firmware without configuring physical hardware or hypervisors.

repositories.name: skylot/jadx
repositories.summary: Dex to Java decompiler and GUI tool for Android APK reverse engineering. Directly extracts Java source code, manifests, and decrypted resources from raw Android APKs.
technicalHighlights: Direct Dalvik bytecode (DEX) to readable Java source lifting
Interactive Java deobfuscator with automated symbol renaming
Integrated debugger and smali bytecode editor
repositories.paradigmShift: Became the universal industry standard for mobile application penetration testing and Android malware triage.

repositories.name: dnSpy/dnSpy
repositories.summary: The premier .NET assembly decompiler, editor, and debugger. Allows live modification of C# / IL code directly inside compiled assemblies without source code access.
technicalHighlights: Direct IL-to-C# decompilation engine using ILSpy decompiler core
Live debugging of Unity game engines and commercial .NET software
In-place assembly patching and binary re-compilation
repositories.paradigmShift: Made .NET reverse engineering as fluid as editing standard source code in an IDE.

repositories.name: x64dbg/x64dbg
repositories.summary: The premier open-source x64/x32 debugger for Windows, built specifically to fill the void left by 32-bit OllyDbg as malware and software transitioned to 64-bit architectures.
technicalHighlights: Modern Qt-based GUI with full script engine and expression evaluator
Scylla hide integration, memory tracing, call stack unwinding, and anti-anti-debugging plugins
Active community plugin architecture powering hundreds of game and malware reversing plugins
repositories.paradigmShift: Became the universal default user-mode debugger for malware reverse engineering on Windows 64-bit.

repositories.name: ReFirmLabs/binwalk
repositories.summary: The undisputed standard tool for searching, extracting, and reverse engineering embedded firmware images, router ROMs, and IoT flash memory dumps.
technicalHighlights: Magic byte signature scanner mapping nested filesystems (SquashFS, CramFS, JFFS2, U-Boot)
Automated recursive extraction and decompression of nested firmware archives
Entropy graphing to detect encrypted bootloaders and compressed payloads
repositories.paradigmShift: Created modern hardware/IoT firmware reverse engineering as an accessible, automated discipline.

repositories.name: angr/angr
repositories.summary: A powerful Python binary analysis framework for dynamic symbolic execution, control-flow graph recovery, automatic vulnerability discovery, and program slicing.
technicalHighlights: VEX IR translation supporting x86, ARM, MIPS, PPC, RISC-V
Integration with Z3 SMT solver for path exploration and constraint solving
Core engine behind Mechanical Phish in the DARPA Cyber Grand Challenge (CGC)
repositories.paradigmShift: Made academic automated binary exploitation and constraint solving accessible via idiomatic Python scripts.

repositories.name: frida/frida
repositories.summary: Dynamic instrumentation toolkit for developers, reverse-engineers, and security researchers that lets you inject JavaScript snippets or native libraries into native apps on Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android.
technicalHighlights: In-process JavaScript engine (QuickJS / V8) hooked into running process memory
Real-time function interception, argument manipulation, and memory scanning
Universal mobile security testing standard (bypassing SSL pinning, root checks, biometrics)
repositories.paradigmShift: Transformed dynamic analysis from recompiling binaries to live, runtime JavaScript hooking on target devices.

repositories.name: capstone-engine/capstone
repositories.summary: The ultimate disassembly framework for binary analysis, security research, and malware triage. Derived from LLVM MC components and ported to lightweight multi-architecture C library.
technicalHighlights: Supports x86, ARM, ARM64, MIPS, PPC, Sparc, SystemZ, XCore, RISC-V, WASM, and more
Detailed semantic information per instruction: registers read/written, instruction groups
Powers Radare2, Rizin, Qiling, angr, and hundreds of security tools
repositories.paradigmShift: Replaced fragile custom disassemblers with a single, universally adopted multi-platform C engine.

repositories.name: unicorn-engine/unicorn
repositories.summary: A lightweight, multi-platform, multi-architecture CPU emulator framework based on QEMU, purpose-built for binary reverse engineering and shellcode emulation.
technicalHighlights: Isolated CPU core emulation without the overhead of whole-system QEMU hardware emulation
Memory hook callbacks on read, write, execute, and invalid memory access
Core execution engine for malware shellcode unpackers and taint analysis engines
repositories.paradigmShift: Gave reverse engineers granular, in-memory execution hooks to unpack polymorphic shellcode safely.

repositories.name: Vector35/binaryninja-api
repositories.summary: Modern reverse engineering platform celebrated for its groundbreaking multi-tiered Intermediate Languages (LLIL, MLIL, HLIL) and pristine Python/C++ API.
technicalHighlights: Tiered SSA-based intermediate representations that preserve semantics through progressive lifting
Asynchronous multi-threaded analysis architecture allowing fluid UI interaction while analyzing large binaries
Modern Vector35 team providing transparent open-source API and plugin ecosystem
repositories.paradigmShift: Proved that layered intermediate representations (Low, Medium, High Level IL) provide far cleaner dataflow analysis than single-tier ASTs.

repositories.name: JonathanSalwan/Triton
repositories.summary: Concolic Execution Engine providing Dynamic Binary Analysis (DBA), Dynamic Symbolic Execution (DSE), and AST representation over assembly instructions.
technicalHighlights: Taint analysis engine tracking user-controlled input bytes across memory and CPU registers
Automatic symbolic formula generation for instructions and branch conditions
Synthesized AST optimization and solver integration (Z3, Bitwuzla)
repositories.paradigmShift: Pioneered automated deobfuscation of virtual machine-based packers and opaque predicates.

repositories.name: pwndbg/pwndbg
repositories.summary: GDB plug-in designed to make debugging with GDB less painful for exploit developers and reverse engineers, with an IDA Pro / OllyDbg styled layout, heap visualizer, and ROP gadgets.
technicalHighlights: Deep glibc heap chunk dissection (tcache, fastbins, unsorted bins)
Context layout displaying registers, disassembly, stack, and backtrace simultaneously
Emulation-assisted conditional jump determination
repositories.paradigmShift: Elevated the ancient GNU Debugger into a world-class binary exploitation and CTF reversing tool.

repositories.name: avast/retdec
repositories.summary: Retargetable machine-code decompiler based on LLVM IR. Open-sourced by Avast, it proved LLVM could be utilized in reverse—lifting binary code to LLVM bitcode and applying standard LLVM passes.
technicalHighlights: Translates machine code (x86, ARM, MIPS, PIC32) directly into LLVM IR
Applies LLVM optimization passes to simplify obfuscated instruction sequences
Full C source code generation and call graph reconstruction
repositories.paradigmShift: Demonstrated the power of leveraging LLVM's rich optimization ecosystem for binary decompilation.

repositories.name: OllyDbg (Historical Archive)
repositories.summary: The ringmaster of 2000s binary analysis. OllyDbg's intuitive four-pane interface (disassembly, registers, stack, dump) defined the mental model of reverse engineering for an entire generation of security hackers.
technicalHighlights: Intuitive heuristic code analysis discovering loops, switch statements, API arguments, and strings
Active inline patching and assembly directly into process memory
Huge ecosystem of unpacking plugins (OllyDump, HideOD, Phantom) to defeat commercial protectors
repositories.paradigmShift: Democratized software reversing from cryptic DOS tools to an interactive Windows desktop visualizer.

repositories.name: PEiD (Executable Identifier)
repositories.summary: The ubiquitous tool of the 2000s for detecting packers, cryptors, and compilers (UPX, ASPack, Themida, Armadillo) using byte signatures, PE header inspection, and entropy calculation.
technicalHighlights: Database of 600+ signature definitions matching entry-point byte sequences
Plugin interface supporting generic OEP (Original Entry Point) finders and dumpers
Foundation for modern signature engines like YARA and capa
repositories.paradigmShift: Established the doctrine of identifying executable wrappers and obfuscators prior to manual disassembly.

repositories.name: Microsoft Sysinternals (Russinovich)
repositories.summary: Process Explorer, Process Monitor (Regmon/Filemon), and ProcDump. The definitive toolkit for dynamic Windows reverse engineering, hooking kernel drivers to reveal every file, registry, and thread interaction.
technicalHighlights: Kernel-level event tracing intercepting I/O request packets (IRPs)
Thread call stack symbol resolution and loaded DLL enumeration
Exposed hidden Windows kernel mechanisms and rootkits (Sony BMG rootkit discovery)
repositories.paradigmShift: Gave reverse engineers complete transparency into OS runtime behavior without attaching a debugger.

repositories.name: Boomerang Decompiler
repositories.summary: One of the earliest attempts to create a complete, open-source general-purpose machine code decompiler translating x86, SPARC, and PowerPC to C based on Cristina Cifuentes' theory.
technicalHighlights: Dataflow analysis with Single Static Assignment (SSA) form
Type inference and structure identification algorithms
Laying the open-source groundwork that inspired later decompiler projects like RetDec and Ghidra
repositories.paradigmShift: Proved that open-source decompilation was academically viable beyond closed commercial labs.

repositories.name: Immunity Debugger
repositories.summary: Built on top of OllyDbg core with a deep Python API integration. Standardized heap spraying analysis, ROP gadget searching (mona.py by Corelan), and automated exploit development.
technicalHighlights: Native Python API exposing memory breakpoints, register states, and disassembly
Birthplace of 'mona.py', the legendary script for bypassing DEP and ASLR
Definitive training tool for the OSCP and OSCE certifications
repositories.paradigmShift: Connected binary debugging directly to programmatic Python automation for offensive exploit creation.

repositories.name: IDA Pro & Hex-Rays Decompiler
repositories.summary: Conceived in 1991 for MS-DOS, IDA evolved into the indisputable gold standard of reverse engineering, culminating in the 2007 debut of the Hex-Rays Decompiler producing structured C code from raw x86 binaries.
technicalHighlights: FLIRT (Fast Library Identification and Recognition Technology) identifying compiler standard libraries
Type propagation engine resolving complex nested structures and virtual function tables (vtables)
Microcode intermediate representation enabling custom decompilation optimization passes
repositories.paradigmShift: Invented the commercial reverse engineering discipline and demonstrated high-level C decompilation from stripped assembly.

repositories.name: rapid7/metasploit-framework
repositories.summary: Created by HD Moore in 2003 (originally in Perl, later rewritten in Ruby), Metasploit revolutionized the interaction between binary reverse engineering and penetration testing by standardizing exploit payloads, encoders, and shellcode.
technicalHighlights: MSFvenom payload generation with automated polymorphism (shikata_ga_nai)
Meterpreter in-memory injected payload providing undetectable stealth command execution
Modular architecture linking vulnerability reverse engineering directly to weaponized modules
repositories.paradigmShift: Turned individual reverse-engineered zero-days into standardized, modular test suites for security practitioners worldwide.

repositories.name: wireshark/wireshark
repositories.summary: Originally named Ethereal, Wireshark is the world's foremost network protocol analyzer, reverse engineering millions of packet streams into clear, dissected protocol trees.
technicalHighlights: Dissector engine with deep protocol knowledge across 3000+ network protocols
Follow TCP/TLS stream reconstructing full application-layer data payloads
Cross-platform packet capture engine via libpcap / Npcap
repositories.paradigmShift: Established the universal visual standard for network protocol reverse engineering.

repositories.name: dcc Decompiler (Cristina Cifuentes)
repositories.summary: The landmark 1994 PhD thesis 'Reverse Compilation Techniques' and its prototype 'dcc' for Intel 80286 DOS binaries. Founded modern decompilation science, introducing Control Flow Graph schema and type analysis.
technicalHighlights: Introduced the foundational schema for structuring high-level loops and conditions from raw jump graphs
First formalized dataflow analysis on machine registers to recover function parameters
Directly inspired Hex-Rays, Boomerang, and NSA Ghidra decompiler architectures
repositories.paradigmShift: Single-handedly transformed reverse compilation from a mathematical impossibility into an exact computer science discipline.

repositories.name: W32Dasm (Windows 32-bit Disassembler)
repositories.summary: The iconic Windows 95/98 GUI disassembler. Known by every software reverse engineer and shareware cracker in the late 1990s for its green jump lines and instant string reference finder.
technicalHighlights: String data reference search locating dialog text ('Invalid Registration Key!') in seconds
Visual jump call navigation with target address resolution
Integrated basic debugger for stepping through PE headers and API imports
repositories.paradigmShift: First tool to make 32-bit Windows PE binary disassembly visual, accessible, and fast for PC enthusiasts.

repositories.name: NuMega SoftICE
repositories.summary: The holy grail of 1990s system debugging and software cracking. SoftICE ran as a Ring 0 driver, capable of freezing the entire operating system (Windows 3.1, 95, 98, NT) instantly at any hardware breakpoint without the target program knowing.
technicalHighlights: Hardware breakpoint interception using x86 DR0-DR7 debug registers
Instant toggle via Ctrl+D overlaying a green-text terminal screen over the entire OS
Rootkit-like invisibility to user-mode anti-debugging tricks
repositories.paradigmShift: Enabled researchers and crackers to conquer ring 0 kernel memory and dismantle early copy protections (SafeDisc, SecuROM).

repositories.name: Sourcer (V Communications)
repositories.summary: The world's first automated 'commenting disassembler' for MS-DOS. Read binary files and generated fully commented 8086/80286/80386 assembly code ready to reassemble with MASM.
technicalHighlights: Automated BIOS and DOS interrupt call annotation (e.g. INT 21h AH=09h -> Display String)
Separation of code execution streams from data tables via multipass analysis
Generated compilable source output matching the original machine code byte-for-byte
repositories.paradigmShift: Proved that automated multi-pass analysis could turn opaque machine code back into readable, re-assemblable source files.

repositories.name: MS-DOS DEBUG.EXE
repositories.stars: The Root of All PC Reversing
repositories.summary: Included in DOS 1.0 through Windows 98. The 'U' (Unassemble) and 'A' (Assemble) commands introduced millions of computer users to CPU registers (AX, BX, CX, DX) and machine code reverse engineering.
technicalHighlights: Direct 16-bit real-mode segment:offset memory inspection and modification
Interactive line assembler and disassembler running in under 20 KB of RAM
Used to inspect BIOS routines, defeat early floppy disk protections, and analyze DOS boot sectors
repositories.paradigmShift: The universal root ancestor of all PC-era binary reverse engineering, debugging, and memory patching.

repositories.name: bminor/binutils-gdb
repositories.summary: The backbone of open-source binary analysis for over 35 years: objdump, readelf, nm, ld, as, and GDB (GNU Debugger). Every modern compiler and reverse engineering tool stands on the shoulders of BFD (Binary File Descriptor).
technicalHighlights: BFD library abstracting object file formats (a.out, COFF, ELF, PE)
objdump disassembler and readelf header parser parsing every UNIX binary
GDB remote serial protocol (RSP) establishing the universal standard for debugger-target communication
repositories.paradigmShift: Created the portable open-source foundation for parsing, linking, and analyzing compiled machine code.

repositories.name: torvalds/linux
repositories.summary: The open-source operating system kernel that powers the modern digital world, supercomputers, Android devices, cloud infrastructures, and the servers that host GitHub itself.
technicalHighlights: Monolithic kernel with dynamic loadable modules (LKM)
Comprehensive support for virtual memory, POSIX standards, and every major architecture
Birthplace of Git itself (created by Linus to manage the Linux kernel development)
repositories.paradigmShift: Redefined the scale, speed, and collaborative potential of open-source software forever.
